commit.message:
Merge Dream and minimap into the complete Lumo Live and Discovery integration

Preserve both real source parents and every existing original-Lumo Hub, Village return, Native52, Live9 and Discovery10 change. Import all 63 unchanged upstream blobs and the independently reviewed two-file reconciliation record.

The exact combined source must pass fresh required engine, renderer, APK and Android acceptance. This commit asserts source integration, not release acceptance.

Merge reviewed Kart minimap repair with exact Dream native integration

Preserve both development parents and all disjoint product, asset and gate changes. Retain original minimap red/green evidence. Verify the combined source with the unchanged 380-check mobile SafeArea probe, recording its actual successful run and complete source identities.

No Host pins or remote refs are updated.

feat(native): connect village and wonder garden to proven Dream baseline [skip ci]

Preserve the exact bd Dream baseline and select 17 original producer files.
Reuse the existing atelier ambience owner and retain a regression that rejects
any duplicate effect in the real production tree. Preserve source originals
and the independent two-file review. This source checkpoint has not run the
new Discovery acceptance; no combined renderer, APK or device claim.

ci(native): bind Discovery probes and rasters to exact original source [skip ci]

Add a separate fresh-output collector and pure replay for10 real probes,
38 decoded original PNGs and2 reports. Bind the complete Git commit/tree,
tracked bytes and original index before and after. Keep the original producer
reader/runner, Dream and52/17 gates unchanged. Add24 focused counterexamples
and a narrowly scoped workflow. Local counterexamples and lint remain pending.

ci(native): activate reviewed source-bound Discovery renderer acceptance

All24 new counterexample cases pass without skips on exact dd3ec7d, and the
new workflow passes one Actionlint invocation. Preserve full original logs
and source/index/import inventories. This evidence-only activation now runs
the exact-checkout workflow with existing Dream gates and new Discovery10/38/2.
checkpoint(village): integrate validated saves and bounded full-world rendering from PR181 [skip ci]
checkpoint(native): bind Village scaling and exact minimap renderer gates [skip ci]
ci(native): activate exact Village and Minimap V2 evidence gates

Merge reviewed Discovery and Village source with preserved minimap history

Keep all baf148b production, gates and notice bytes unchanged. Both common Kart/SafeArea blobs already match e2d15. Preserve the32 additional e2 evidence originals without treating their historic results as acceptance of this merge.

Immutable tree comparison and independent source review completed. No new engine, renderer, Native52, Android or Play execution is claimed. This commit is prepared without updating a ref.

@@ -0,0 +1,507 @@
+name: Lumo Discovery connections separate native acceptance
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [integration/lumo-discovery-bd-20261114]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-discovery-connections-integration-lumo-discovery-bd-20261114
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  discovery-native-acceptance:
+    if: >-
+      github.repository == 'Ullmann27/lumo-godot' &&
+      github.event_name == 'push' &&
+      github.ref == 'refs/heads/integration/lumo-discovery-bd-20261114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    # Existing four headless probes: 1,080s; five Dream probes: 780s.
+    # Discovery ten probes: 3,630s (old learning headless 420s, capture 900s).
+    # Import: 420s. Additional Village gates: 420s economy + 180s/300s scaling.
+    # Additional original MobileSafeArea renderer: 420s, retaining its existing mode limit.
+    # Total explicit probe/import bounds: 7,230s; 570s remain for setup/replay/upload.
+    # This isolated Native job does not change any Host budget or Native52/17 contract.
+    timeout-minutes: 130
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        shell: bash
+    env:
+      LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
+      GODOT_SILENCE_ROOT_WARNING: '1'
+      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+      GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS: '0'
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out the exact internal Discovery push
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Bind the original source and external evidence directories
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-discovery-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
+          LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR="$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/evidence"
+          mkdir "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT"
+          mkdir -p "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source" \
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests" "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/headless" \
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/engine" "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/tmp" \
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/xdg/data" "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/xdg/config" "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/xdg/cache"
+          {
+            printf 'LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT=%s\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT"
+            printf 'LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR=%s\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR"
+            printf 'GODOT_BIN=%s/engine/bin/godot\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT"
+            printf 'LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON=%s/venv/bin/python\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT"
+            printf 'LUMO_DREAM_LOG_DIR=%s/dream\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR"
+            printf 'LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_SHA=%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA"
+            printf 'LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_TREE=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
+            printf 'TMPDIR=%s/tmp\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT"
+            printf 'XDG_DATA_HOME=%s/xdg/data\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT"
+            printf 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME=%s/xdg/config\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT"
+            printf 'XDG_CACHE_HOME=%s/xdg/cache\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          git rev-parse HEAD > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/sha-before.txt"
+          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/tree-before.txt"
+          git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/status-before.txt"
+          git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/all-status-before.txt"
+          git ls-files --stage > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-before.txt"
+          sha256sum "$(git rev-parse --git-path index)" | cut -d ' ' -f 1 \
+            > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-sha256-before.txt"
+          printf 'repository=%s\nref=%s\nsource=%s\nrun=%s\nattempt=%s\njob=%s\n' \
+            "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$GITHUB_REF" "$GITHUB_SHA" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
+            "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" "$GITHUB_JOB" > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/workflow-context.txt"
+          test "$(cat "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/sha-before.txt")" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
+          test ! -s "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/status-before.txt"
+
+      - name: Install the verified engine and external Pillow environment
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          {
+            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 update -qq &&
+            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 install -y xvfb libgl1-mesa-dri libglx-mesa0 python3-venv &&
+            curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/engine/godot.zip" \
+              https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.6.3-stable/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip &&
+            printf '%s  %s\n' d0bc2113065e481c9c2c2b2c37daa4e8be3fe9e27f0ab9ab0b6096e9a37907f3 \
+              "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/engine/godot.zip" | sha256sum -c - &&
+            unzip -q "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/engine/godot.zip" -d "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/engine/bin" &&
+            ln -s "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/engine/bin/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64" "$GODOT_BIN" &&
+            "$GODOT_BIN" --version > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/engine.txt" &&
+            cat "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/engine.txt" &&
+            test "$(cat "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/engine.txt")" = 4.6.3.stable.official.7d41c59c4 &&
+            python3 -m venv "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/venv" &&
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir Pillow==12.3.0 &&
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" --version &&
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" -c 'import PIL; print("Pillow " + PIL.__version__); assert PIL.__version__ == "12.3.0"' &&
+            command -v xvfb-run &&
+            printf '%s\n' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/engine/bin" "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+          } 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/setup.log"
+
+      - name: Bind the unchanged helpers before any import or test
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          printf '%s  %s\n' \
+            55591b4478d2074135ea4950fb00200d68a3f9bede286b39642d7fc17aa586da tools/verify_discovery_rasters.py \
+            f7296a802d15c382dbcc77640373a0f53e30306fcaab3de869549ff1656de89d tools/verify_dream_rasters.py \
+            e1836029a196e4dcd4a4f47fd8c2010c5b460ec5bf4c0578e90e75d3a5d2ea13 tools/run_godot_probe.py \
+            | sha256sum -c - | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/helper-sha256.log"
+          test "$(git hash-object tools/verify_discovery_rasters.py)" = 219e691fc8aa119cc80221b3db6c77e63caf8bfe
+          test "$(git hash-object tools/verify_dream_rasters.py)" = da8eed7d6383fcbc82a03596518a5fcc3b9a00c5
+          test "$(git hash-object tools/run_godot_probe.py)" = c23859ece2d62101d000d7a89556fda5d3fe4105
+          "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" tools/verify_dream_rasters.py "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/source" \
+            --snapshot-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --snapshot-phase before
+
+      - name: Require the separate Dream raster counterexamples
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" -m unittest tools.tests.test_dream_rasters -v \
+            2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/dream-raster-tests.log"
+          test "$(grep -Ec '^Ran 12 tests in [0-9.]+s$' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/dream-raster-tests.log")" = 1
+          test "$(grep -Fxc 'OK' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/dream-raster-tests.log")" = 1
+
+      - name: Require the strict Discovery counterexamples and original reader tests
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" -m unittest tools.tests.test_discovery_connections -v \
+            2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/discovery-originals-tests.log"
+          test "$(grep -Ec '^Ran 24 tests in [0-9.]+s$' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/discovery-originals-tests.log")" = 1
+          test "$(grep -Fxc 'OK' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/discovery-originals-tests.log")" = 1
+          PYTHONPATH=tools:tools/tests "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" -m unittest test_discovery_rasters -v \
+            2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/discovery-producer-reader-tests.log"
+          test "$(grep -Ec '^Ran 11 tests in [0-9.]+s$' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/discovery-producer-reader-tests.log")" = 1
+          test "$(grep -Fxc 'OK' "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/discovery-producer-reader-tests.log")" = 1
+
+      - name: Import the exact production project with a strict error guard
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 420s "$GODOT_BIN" \
+            --headless --audio-driver Dummy --path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --editor --import --quit \
+            2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/import.log"
+          if grep -En 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:|Assertion failed|ObjectDB instances leaked|resources still in use at exit' \
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/import.log"; then
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Preserve the four existing exact headless acceptance gates
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          check_headless() {
+            local name="$1" seconds="$2" marker="$3"
+            local proof="$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/headless/$name.log"
+            local state="$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/xdg/$name"
+            mkdir -p "$state/data" "$state/config" "$state/cache" || return 1
+            XDG_DATA_HOME="$state/data" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$state/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$state/cache" \
+              "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" tools/run_godot_probe.py \
+              --log "$proof" --timeout "$seconds" --required "$marker" -- \
+              "$GODOT_BIN" --headless --audio-driver Dummy --path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
+              --script "res://scripts/tests/$name.gd" || return $?
+            if grep -En 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:|Assertion failed|ObjectDB instances leaked|resources still in use at exit' "$proof"; then
+              return 1
+            fi
+            local count
+            if ! count="$(grep -Fxc -- "$marker" "$proof")"; then
+              return 1
+            fi
+            test "$count" = 1
+          }
+          {
+            check_headless connect_four_return_regression 60 'CONNECT_FOUR_RETURN_PASS checks=21' || exit 1
+            check_headless treasure_wisp_regression 180 '[TreasureWisp] PASS checks=14' || exit 1
+            check_headless treasure_exploration_regression 420 \
+              '[TreasureExploration] PASS 92 checks: branching, actual location questions, movement, legacy saves and original rewards' || exit 1
+            check_headless learning_world_regression 420 '[LearningWorld] PASS checks=5347' || exit 1
+          } 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/headless/runner.log"
+
+      - name: Collect all five new Dream gates and seven original renderer images
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test ! -e "$LUMO_DREAM_LOG_DIR"
+          test ! -L "$LUMO_DREAM_LOG_DIR"
+          test "$LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_SHA" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
+          bash tools/validate_dream_connections.sh 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/dream-runner.log"
+          test "$(grep -Fxc '[LumoDreamConnections] PASS 5 original probes and 7 verified renderer PNGs' \
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/dream-runner.log")" = 1
+
+      - name: Require ten source-bound Discovery probes and all original 38 PNGs and two reports
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" tools/collect_discovery_connections.py \
+            --project "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --output "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/discovery" \
+            --expected-native-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" --expected-native-tree "$LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_TREE" \
+            --godot "$GODOT_BIN" 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/discovery-collector.log"
+          test "$(grep -Fxc '[DiscoveryOriginals] PASS 10 exact probes, 38 decoded PNGs and 2 original reports' \
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/discovery-collector.log")" = 1
+          "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" tools/verify_discovery_connections.py "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/discovery" \
+            --expected-native-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" --expected-native-tree "$LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_TREE" \
+            > "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/discovery-read-only-replay.log"
+          test "$(grep -Fxc '[DiscoveryOriginals] PASS 10 exact probes, 38 decoded PNGs and 2 original reports' \
+            "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/discovery-read-only-replay.log")" = 1
+
+      - name: Require exact village save schema and bounded original renderer evidence
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT="$LUMO_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE_DIR/village-scaling"
+          test ! -e "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT"
+          test ! -L "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT"
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_SHA"
+          test "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')" = "$LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_TREE"
+          printf '%s  %s\n' \
+            f7296a802d15c382dbcc77640373a0f53e30306fcaab3de869549ff1656de89d tools/verify_dream_rasters.py \
+            e1836029a196e4dcd4a4f47fd8c2010c5b460ec5bf4c0578e90e75d3a5d2ea13 tools/run_godot_probe.py \
+            | sha256sum -c -
+          test "$(git hash-object tools/verify_dream_rasters.py)" = da8eed7d6383fcbc82a03596518a5fcc3b9a00c5
+          test "$(git hash-object tools/run_godot_probe.py)" = c23859ece2d62101d000d7a89556fda5d3fe4105
+          test "$(git hash-object scripts/tests/build_village_economy_regression.gd)" = 9dd8ff269e266dd73ad5207febd87aab367a4986
+          test "$(git hash-object scripts/tests/build_village_scaling_regression.gd)" = c6abdb5f9576c0b48db7bd59716da52ea5fac036
+          mkdir "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT"
+          mkdir "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/logs" "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/captures" "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/source"
+          "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" tools/verify_dream_rasters.py "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/source" \
+            --snapshot-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --snapshot-phase before
+          check_village() {
+            local name="$1" script="$2" mode="$3" seconds="$4" marker="$5"
+            local proof="$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/logs/$name.log"
+            local runner="$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/logs/$name.runner.log"
+            local state="$LUMO_DISCOVERY_ROOT/xdg/village-$name"
+            mkdir "$state" || return 1
+            mkdir "$state/data" "$state/config" "$state/cache" || return 1
+            if [[ "$mode" == headless ]]; then
+              XDG_DATA_HOME="$state/data" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$state/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$state/cache" \
+                "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" tools/run_godot_probe.py \
+                --log "$proof" --timeout "$seconds" --required "$marker" -- \
+                "$GODOT_BIN" --headless --audio-driver Dummy --path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
+                --script "res://scripts/tests/$script.gd" 2>&1 | tee "$runner" || return $?
+            elif [[ "$mode" == rendered ]]; then
+              XDG_DATA_HOME="$state/data" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$state/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$state/cache" \
+                LUMO_CAPTURE_DIR="$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/captures" \
+                "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" tools/run_godot_probe.py \
+                --log "$proof" --timeout "$seconds" --required "$marker" -- \
+                xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x720x24" "$GODOT_BIN" \
+                --audio-driver Dummy --path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --rendering-method gl_compatibility \
+                --resolution 1280x720 --script "res://scripts/tests/$script.gd" -- --capture \
+                2>&1 | tee "$runner" || return $?
+            else
+              return 1
+            fi
+            cmp "$proof" "$runner" || return 1
+            test "$(grep -Fxc -- "$marker" "$proof")" = 1 || return 1
+            if grep -En 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:|Assertion failed|ObjectDB instances leaked|resources still in use at exit|\[ProbeRunner\] (FAIL|timeout)' "$proof"; then
+              return 1
+            fi
+          }
+          {
+            check_village 01-economy-headless build_village_economy_regression headless 420 \
+              '[VillageEconomy] PASS 339 checks' || exit 1
+            # New bounded-workload budgets: 2178 saved houses, five view states, two PNGs.
+            # These 180s/300s bounds are not an asserted original Producer timeout.
+            check_village 02-scaling-headless build_village_scaling_regression headless 180 \
+              '[VillageScaling] PASS 42 checks: full 2178-house model, camera and explorer' || exit 1
+            check_village 03-scaling-rendered build_village_scaling_regression rendered 300 \
+              '[VillageScaling] PASS 46 checks: full 2178-house model, camera and explorer' || exit 1
+          } 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/runner.log"
+          "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" tools/verify_dream_rasters.py "$LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT/source" \
+            --snapshot-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --snapshot-phase after
+          "$LUMO_DISCOVERY_PYTHON" - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, subprocess
+          root = pathlib.Path(os.environ["LUMO_VILLAGE_OUTPUT"])
+          project = pathlib.Path(os.environ["GITHUB_WORKSPACE"])
+          helper = project / "tools/verify_dream_rasters.py"
+          raw = helper.read_bytes()
+          if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != "f7296a802d15c382dbcc77640373a0f53e30306fcaab3de869549ff1656de89d":
+              raise SystemExit("Village evidence reader SHA256 changed")
+          if hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + bytes([0]) + raw).hexdigest() != "da8eed7d6383fcbc82a03596518a5fcc3b9a00c5":
+              raise SystemExit("Village evidence reader Git blob changed")
+          spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("village_original_reader", helper)
+          reader = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+          spec.loader.exec_module(reader)
+          before, before_record = reader.original_json(root, "source/source-inventory-before.json")
+          after, after_record = reader.original_json(root, "source/source-inventory-after.json")
+          expected = (os.environ["LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_SHA"], os.environ["LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_TREE"])
+          for value in (before, after):
+              reader.require((value["head"], value["tree"]) == expected, "Foreign Village source")
+              reader.require(all(row["materialized"] is True for row in value["tracked"]), "Incomplete Village source checkout")
+          for key in ("head", "tree", "index_sha256", "tracked"):
+              reader.require(before[key] == after[key], "Village tracked source/index changed: " + key)
+          probes = (
+              ("01-economy-headless", "build_village_economy_regression", "headless", 420, "[VillageEconomy] PASS 339 checks"),
+              ("02-scaling-headless", "build_village_scaling_regression", "headless", 180, "[VillageScaling] PASS 42 checks: full 2178-house model, camera and explorer"),
+              ("03-scaling-rendered", "build_village_scaling_regression", "rendered", 300, "[VillageScaling] PASS 46 checks: full 2178-house model, camera and explorer"),
+          )
+          originals = []
+          banner = "Godot Engine v" + reader.ENGINE + " - https://godotengine.org"
+          for name, script, mode, timeout, marker in probes:
+              text, log_record = reader.original_text(root, "logs/" + name + ".log")
+              runner, runner_record = reader.original_text(root, "logs/" + name + ".runner.log")
+              reader.require(text == runner, "Village original/runner bytes differ: " + name)
+              reader.require(text.splitlines().count(banner) == 1, "Village requires one real engine invocation: " + name)
+              reader.require(text.splitlines().count(marker) == 1, "Village exact original marker missing/duplicated: " + name)
+              reader.require(reader.ERRORS.search(text) is None, "Village original contains a runtime failure: " + name)
+              originals.append({"probe": script, "mode": mode, "timeout_seconds": timeout, "required_marker": marker, "log": log_record, "runner": runner_record})
+          names = ("01-home-region.png", "02-river-boundary.png")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+
+def identity(data: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    return (hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest(),
+            hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
+
+
+def regular(path: Path) -> bytes:
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f'Expected original regular file: {path}')
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def main(spec_path: Path) -> None:
+    spec = json.loads(spec_path.read_text())
+    root = Path(spec['output_directory'])
+    if root.exists():
+        raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an existing prepared publication')
+    documents = root / 'documents'
+    chunks_dir = root / 'gitdata'
+    documents.mkdir(parents=True)
+    chunks_dir.mkdir()
+    files = []
+    archive_records = []
+    loader = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('evidence_archive', '/tmp/lumo-root-recovery-0900/prepare_host79_evidence.py')
+    helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(loader)
+    loader.loader.exec_module(helper)
+    helper.DOCS = documents
+    for item in spec.get('copies', []):
+        archive_records.append(helper.copy_original(Path(item['source']), item['destination'], item.get('sha256')))
+    for item in spec.get('archives', []):
+        archive_records.append(helper.archive_pack(Path(item['source']), item['destination'], item['manifest_sha256']))
+    for item in spec.get('source_files', []):
+        source = Path(item['source'])
+        data = regular(source)
+        blob, sha256 = identity(data)
+        if blob != item['git_blob'] or sha256 != item['sha256']:
+            raise ValueError(f'Frozen source identity changed: {source}')
+        files.append({'path': item['path'], 'source': str(source), 'mode': item.get('mode', '100644')})
+    (documents / 'root-connection.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec['connection'], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    (documents / 'original-archive-bindings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'schema': 1, 'files': archive_records}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    (documents / 'prepare-connection.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
+    for source in sorted(documents.rglob('*')):
+        if source.is_file():
+            files.append({'path': spec['evidence_prefix'] + '/' + source.relative_to(documents).as_posix(),
+                          'source': str(source), 'mode': '100644'})
+    entries = []
+    blobs = []
+    local_files = []
+    inventory = []
+    paths = set()
+    seen_blobs = set()
+    for item in files:
+        path = item['path']
+        if path.startswith('/') or any(p in ('', '.', '..') for p in path.split('/')) or path in paths:
+            raise ValueError(f'Unsafe or duplicate publication path: {path}')
+        paths.add(path)
+        data = regular(Path(item['source']))
+        sha, sha256 = identity(data)
+        entry = {'path': path, 'mode': item['mode'], 'type': 'blob', 'sha': sha}
+        entries.append(entry)
+        local_files.append({'entry': entry, 'file': item['source']})
+        inventory.append({'path': path, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': sha256, 'git_blob': sha})
+        if sha in seen_blobs:
+            continue
+        seen_blobs.add(sha)
+        try:
+            content = data.decode('utf-8')
+            encoding = 'utf-8'
+        except UnicodeDecodeError:
+            content = base64.b64encode(data).decode('ascii')
+            encoding = 'base64'
+        chunks = []
+        for offset in range(0, max(1, len(content)), 30000):
+            chunk = chunks_dir / f'{sha}-{offset // 30000:04d}.chunk'
+            chunk.write_bytes(content[offset:offset + 30000].encode('utf-8'))
+            chunks.append(str(chunk))
+        blobs.append({'sha': sha, 'encoding': encoding, 'bytes': len(data), 'characters': len(content),
+                      'chunks': chunks, 'source_path': path})
+    plan = {key: spec[key] for key in ('repository_full_name', 'parent_sha', 'base_tree', 'branch_name', 'message')}
+    plan.update({'local_commit': None, 'entries': entries, 'blobs': blobs})
+    result = {'plan': plan, 'local_files': local_files, 'inventory': inventory}
+    (root / 'prepared.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps({'prepared': str(root / 'prepared.json'), 'paths': len(entries),
+                      'source_paths': len(spec.get('source_files', [])), 'bytes': sum(x['bytes'] for x in inventory)}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main(Path(sys.argv[1]))

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+
+def identity(data: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    return (hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest(),
+            hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
+
+
+def regular(path: Path) -> bytes:
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f'Expected original regular file: {path}')
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def main(spec_path: Path) -> None:
+    spec = json.loads(spec_path.read_text())
+    root = Path(spec['output_directory'])
+    if root.exists():
+        raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an existing prepared publication')
+    documents = root / 'documents'
+    chunks_dir = root / 'gitdata'
+    documents.mkdir(parents=True)
+    chunks_dir.mkdir()
+    files = []
+    archive_records = []
+    loader = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('evidence_archive', '/tmp/lumo-root-recovery-0900/prepare_host79_evidence.py')
+    helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(loader)
+    loader.loader.exec_module(helper)
+    helper.DOCS = documents
+    for item in spec.get('copies', []):
+        archive_records.append(helper.copy_original(Path(item['source']), item['destination'], item.get('sha256')))
+    for item in spec.get('archives', []):
+        archive_records.append(helper.archive_pack(Path(item['source']), item['destination'], item['manifest_sha256']))
+    for item in spec.get('source_files', []):
+        source = Path(item['source'])
+        data = regular(source)
+        blob, sha256 = identity(data)
+        if blob != item['git_blob'] or sha256 != item['sha256']:
+            raise ValueError(f'Frozen source identity changed: {source}')
+        files.append({'path': item['path'], 'source': str(source), 'mode': item.get('mode', '100644')})
+    (documents / 'root-connection.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec['connection'], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    (documents / 'original-archive-bindings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'schema': 1, 'files': archive_records}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    (documents / 'prepare-connection.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
+    for source in sorted(documents.rglob('*')):
+        if source.is_file():
+            files.append({'path': spec['evidence_prefix'] + '/' + source.relative_to(documents).as_posix(),
+                          'source': str(source), 'mode': '100644'})
+    entries = []
+    blobs = []
+    local_files = []
+    inventory = []
+    paths = set()
+    seen_blobs = set()
+    for item in files:
+        path = item['path']
+        if path.startswith('/') or any(p in ('', '.', '..') for p in path.split('/')) or path in paths:
+            raise ValueError(f'Unsafe or duplicate publication path: {path}')
+        paths.add(path)
+        data = regular(Path(item['source']))
+        sha, sha256 = identity(data)
+        entry = {'path': path, 'mode': item['mode'], 'type': 'blob', 'sha': sha}
+        entries.append(entry)
+        local_files.append({'entry': entry, 'file': item['source']})
+        inventory.append({'path': path, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': sha256, 'git_blob': sha})
+        if sha in seen_blobs:
+            continue
+        seen_blobs.add(sha)
+        try:
+            content = data.decode('utf-8')
+            encoding = 'utf-8'
+        except UnicodeDecodeError:
+            content = base64.b64encode(data).decode('ascii')
+            encoding = 'base64'
+        chunks = []
+        for offset in range(0, max(1, len(content)), 30000):
+            chunk = chunks_dir / f'{sha}-{offset // 30000:04d}.chunk'
+            chunk.write_bytes(content[offset:offset + 30000].encode('utf-8'))
+            chunks.append(str(chunk))
+        blobs.append({'sha': sha, 'encoding': encoding, 'bytes': len(data), 'characters': len(content),
+                      'chunks': chunks, 'source_path': path})
+    plan = {key: spec[key] for key in ('repository_full_name', 'parent_sha', 'base_tree', 'branch_name', 'message')}
+    plan.update({'local_commit': None, 'entries': entries, 'blobs': blobs})
+    result = {'plan': plan, 'local_files': local_files, 'inventory': inventory}
+    (root / 'prepared.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps({'prepared': str(root / 'prepared.json'), 'paths': len(entries),
+                      'source_paths': len(spec.get('source_files', [])), 'bytes': sum(x['bytes'] for x in inventory)}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main(Path(sys.argv[1]))

+def identity(data: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    return (hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest(),
+            hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
+

+def regular(path: Path) -> bytes:
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f'Expected original regular file: {path}')
+    return path.read_bytes()

+    for item in spec.get('source_files', []):
+        source = Path(item['source'])
+        data = regular(source)
+        blob, sha256 = identity(data)

+# Village and Minimap2 gates — version 2
+
+This source pack proposes exactly three active paths on c040: the Discovery workflow and the two byte-exact published Minimap2 sources. The two product/probe blobs and the complete c040 validation archive are unchanged from v1.
+
+V2 closes the missing real Minimap renderer gate. After the additional Village modes, one separate MobileSafeArea render invocation uses the existing 420-second limit and --capture. LUMO_CAPTURE_DIR holds the four original SafeArea images and the unchanged original report; LUMO_KART_MINIMAP_CAPTURE_DIR holds nine additional minimap frames. The reader requires an exact successful Engine marker matched to the original report's check count, empty failures, all 15 existing SafeArea/48dp targets, seven ordered layouts and two ordered hint transitions. Every one of the 13 PNGs is bound to its actual report path, dimensions and original SHA, fully decoded through the unchanged hash-bound Dream PNG reader, and additionally given a decoded RGB hash. Original report bytes are never rewritten.
+
+The old 47 Python cases, four prior headless gates, Dream 5/7/2, Discovery 10/38/2, all source/index guards and always-upload remain unchanged. Village Economy retains 420 seconds; Scaling's new explicit limits remain 180/300 seconds. The added MobileSafeArea mode retains its existing 420 seconds. Only the isolated Native job moves to the explicitly authorized 130 minutes: 7,230 seconds of probe/import bounds plus 570 seconds for setup, replay and upload. No Host budget, 52-mode roster, 17-image contract or TitleContrast600 change.
+
+The c040 archive contains the actual clean import, Economy339 and Scaling42 passes plus the complete blocked Xorg attempt. It contains no Scaling46 result and no PNG. The next combined source still needs actual MobileSafeArea execution and fresh CI rendering. No old Discovery result, Android result or physical-device/FPS claim is transferred. The v1 source/review remain untouched; workflow-v1-to-v2.patch isolates only this follow-up.

+extends Node3D
+## Purely decorative, budgeted real 3D meshes behind the original Lumo fox.
+## Does not touch saved game state, gameplay physics or Android permissions.
+var reduced_motion := false
+var _clock := 0.0
+var _arch_orbit: Node3D
+var _firefly_orbit: Node3D
+var _ground_disc: MeshInstance3D
+
+
+func set_reduced_motion(enabled: bool) -> void:
+	reduced_motion = enabled
+	set_process(not enabled)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_build_portal()
+	set_process(not reduced_motion)
+
+
+func _material(color: Color, glow: float = 0.0) -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	var result := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	result.albedo_color = color
+	result.roughness = 0.35
+	result.metallic = 0.22
+	if glow > 0.0:
+		result.emission_enabled = true
+		result.emission = color
+		result.emission_energy_multiplier = glow
+	return result
+
+
+func _ring(
+	parent: Node3D, name_value: String, inner: float, outer: float,
+	location: Vector3, material: Material
+) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mesh := TorusMesh.new()
+	mesh.inner_radius = inner
+	mesh.outer_radius = outer
+	mesh.rings = 56
+	mesh.ring_segments = 8
+	var node := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	node.name = name_value
+	node.mesh = mesh
+	node.material_override = material
+	node.position = location
+	node.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	parent.add_child(node)
+	return node
+
+
+func _build_portal() -> void:
+	# A small landing platform supports Lumo's feet without hiding his model.
+	var platform_mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
+	platform_mesh.top_radius = 2.35
+	platform_mesh.bottom_radius = 2.5
+	platform_mesh.height = 0.12
+	platform_mesh.radial_segments = 48
+	_ground_disc = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	_ground_disc.name = "LumoLandingIsland"
+	_ground_disc.mesh = platform_mesh
+	_ground_disc.position = Vector3(0, -0.39, -0.35)
+	_ground_disc.material_override = _material(Color("224863"))
+	add_child(_ground_disc)
+	_ring(
+		self, "LumoLandingGlow", 2.27, 2.34, Vector3(0, -0.32, -0.35),
+		_material(Color("65e9f7"), 1.15)
+	)
+	_arch_orbit = Node3D.new()
+	_arch_orbit.name = "DreamArchOrbit"
+	_arch_orbit.position = Vector3(0, 1.32, -1.7)
+	add_child(_arch_orbit)
+	var arch := _ring(
+		_arch_orbit, "LumoDreamPortalRing", 1.55, 1.66, Vector3.ZERO,
+		_material(Color("70e8ff"), 1.5)
+	)
+	arch.rotation.x = PI * 0.5
+	var second := _ring(
+		_arch_orbit, "LumoGoldPortalRing", 1.83, 1.89, Vector3(0, 0, -0.1),
+		_material(Color("ffcf78"), 1.25)
+	)
+	second.rotation.x = PI * 0.5
+	_firefly_orbit = Node3D.new()
+	_firefly_orbit.name = "DreamFireflyOrbit"
+	_arch_orbit.add_child(_firefly_orbit)
+	var glow_sphere := SphereMesh.new()
+	glow_sphere.radius = 0.05
+	glow_sphere.height = 0.1
+	glow_sphere.radial_segments = 8
+	glow_sphere.rings = 4
+	var instancing := MultiMesh.new()
+	instancing.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+	instancing.mesh = glow_sphere
+	instancing.instance_count = 28
+	for index in range(instancing.instance_count):
+		var angle := float(index) * TAU / float(instancing.instance_count)
+		var radius := 1.78 + 0.13 * sin(float(index) * 2.17)
+		var position := Vector3(
+			cos(angle) * radius,
+			sin(angle) * radius,
+			-0.05 - float(index % 4) * 0.11
+		)
+		instancing.set_instance_transform(index, Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY, position))
+	var fireflies := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+	fireflies.name = "LumoDreamFireflies"
+	fireflies.multimesh = instancing
+	fireflies.material_override = _material(Color("ffe9a2"), 1.65)
+	fireflies.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	_firefly_orbit.add_child(fireflies)
+	# Two short shoreline lanterns add real parallax without extra textures.
+	var lamp_mesh := SphereMesh.new()
+	lamp_mesh.radius = 0.17
+	lamp_mesh.height = 0.34
+	lamp_mesh.radial_segments = 12
+	lamp_mesh.rings = 6
+	var lamp_material := _material(Color("8cf7ff"), 1.2)
+	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var lamp := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		lamp.name = "ShoreLantern" + str(int(side))
+		lamp.mesh = lamp_mesh
+		lamp.position = Vector3(side * 2.1, 0.17, -0.64)
+		lamp.material_override = lamp_material
+		lamp.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+		add_child(lamp)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if reduced_motion or not is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	_clock += minf(delta, 0.05)
+	_arch_orbit.rotation.y = 0.16 * sin(_clock * 0.38)
+	_firefly_orbit.rotation.z = 0.11 * sin(_clock * 0.62)
+	_ground_disc.position.y = -0.39 + 0.017 * sin(_clock * 0.6)
+
+
+func _notification(what: int) -> void:
+	if what == NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_PAUSED:
+		set_process(false)
+	elif what == NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_RESUMED and not reduced_motion:
+		set_process(true)

+extends RefCounted
+## One native entrance per playable Godot world. Flutter host game tiles remain
+## independent and retain their original routing, saves and child identities.
+const ENTRIES: Array[Dictionary] = [
+	{"destination": "kart", "title": "LUMO KART", "subtitle": "Sonnenhafen-Cup", "accent": "ffc94a", "featured": true},
+	{"destination": "settlement", "title": "DORF & WIRTSCHAFT", "subtitle": "Dein lebendiges Dorf", "accent": "91efbd", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "jump", "title": "WOLKENINSELN", "subtitle": "Hüpfen & Entdecken", "accent": "53ddfd", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "puzzle", "title": "PUZZLE-ATELIER", "subtitle": "Bilder zum Leben erwecken", "accent": "c4a7ff", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "treasure", "title": "SCHATZSUCHE", "subtitle": "Das Inselgeheimnis", "accent": "ffd18d", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "rhythm", "title": "RHYTHM PARTY", "subtitle": "Spielen zum Beat", "accent": "ff9fd2", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "build", "title": "BAUWELT", "subtitle": "Bauen & Gestalten", "accent": "88eeb2", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "stars", "title": "STERNENJAGD", "subtitle": "Sterne entdecken", "accent": "b99bff", "featured": false},
+]
+
+
+static func launch_options_for(
+	destination: String, original: Dictionary, grade: int, subject: String
+) -> Dictionary:
+	var known := false
+	for portal in ENTRIES:
+		if portal.destination == destination:
+			known = true
+			break
+	if not known:
+		return {}
+	var options: Dictionary = original.duplicate(true)
+	options["grade"] = clampi(grade, 1, 4)
+	options["subject"] = "Deutsch" if subject == "Deutsch" else "Mathematik"
+	if destination == "settlement":
+		options["settlementMode"] = "settlement"
+		options["livingVillage"] = true
+	return options

+extends Node3D
+## Presentation-only reaction to the existing lesson. Never writes task,
+## profile, reward or speech state. Five blooms are decorative progress,
+## not counters, answers or a second learning score.
+const AMBIENCE = preload("res://scripts/systems/render/lumo_dream_ambience.gd")
+const PETAL_SHADER = preload("res://assets/shaders/learning_wonder_petals.gdshader")
+const FLOWERS := 5
+const PETALS := 7
+const MAX_BATCHES := 7
+
+var _world: Node3D
+var _activity: RefCounted
+var _ambience: Node3D
+var _petal_material: ShaderMaterial
+var _pollen_material: StandardMaterial3D
+var _batches: Array[MultiMeshInstance3D] = []
+var _positions: Array[Vector3] = []
+var _progress := 0.0
+var _display_progress := 0.0
+var _kind := "invalid"
+var _family := ""
+var _reduced_motion := false
+var _suspended := false
+var _last_frozen := false
+var _size := Vector2.ZERO
+var _theme_changes := 0
+var _layout_changes := 0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	name = "LearningWonderGarden"
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE
+	_world = get_parent().get_parent() as Node3D
+	if _world == null:
+		set_process(false)
+		return
+	_activity = _world.get("activity") as RefCounted
+	if _activity == null or str(_activity.get("kind")) == "invalid":
+		# An invalid activity does not allocate decorative objects or imply progress.
+		hide()
+		set_process(false)
+		return
+	_build_geometry()
+	# The production atelier already owns this effect; reuse that exact owner.
+	_ambience = AMBIENCE.attach(get_parent() as Node3D, "learning_garden")
+	_observe_activity(true)
+	_sync_motion(true)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_world) or _activity == null:
+		return
+	_sync_motion()
+	if _suspended:
+		return
+	_observe_activity(false)
+	if not is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	var next: float = (
+		_progress if _reduced_motion
+		else move_toward(_display_progress, _progress, clampf(delta, 0.0, 0.1) * 2.4)
+	)
+	if not is_equal_approx(next, _display_progress):
+		_display_progress = next
+		_petal_material.set_shader_parameter("progress", _display_progress)
+
+
+func _sync_motion(force := false) -> void:
+	_reduced_motion = bool(_world.get("reduced_motion"))
+	_suspended = bool(_world.get("suspended"))
+	var frozen := _reduced_motion or _suspended or not is_visible_in_tree()
+	if is_instance_valid(_ambience) and (force or frozen != _last_frozen):
+		# The learning scene's actual options, not an unrelated router default,
+		# own accessibility. Pause retains the static composition.
+		_ambience.set_reduced_motion(frozen)
+	_last_frozen = frozen
+
+
+func _observe_activity(instant: bool) -> void:
+	var current_kind: String = str(_activity.get("kind"))
+	var valid := current_kind != "invalid"
+	visible = valid
+	if current_kind != _kind or _family.is_empty():
+		_kind = current_kind
+		_size = Vector2.ZERO
+		_apply_theme()
+	var completed := 0
+	var total := 1
+	if _kind == "plant_parts":
+		completed = int(_activity.get("watered")) + int(_activity.get("sunlight"))
+		completed += _activity.get("inspected").size()
+		total = 6
+	elif valid:
+		completed = _activity.get("placed").size()
+		total = maxi(1, int(_activity.call("goal_count")))
+	_progress = clampf(float(completed) / float(total), 0.0, 1.0) if valid else 0.0
+	if valid and bool(_activity.call("is_complete")):
+		_progress = 1.0
+	if instant or _reduced_motion or _progress < _display_progress:
+		# Reset is immediate; revisiting an explanation never inherits a bloom.
+		_display_progress = _progress
+		_petal_material.set_shader_parameter("progress", _display_progress)
+	var viewport_size := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
+	if viewport_size != _size:
+		_size = viewport_size
+		_position_geometry(viewport_size.x < viewport_size.y * 0.95)
+
+
+func _apply_theme() -> void:
+	_family = "nature" if _kind == "plant_parts" else ("language" if _kind == "syllables" else "numbers")
+	var warm := Color("eeb86a")
+	var cool := Color("62c2c2")
+	if _family == "language":
+		warm = Color("eaa0b9")
+		cool = Color("a9a2df")
+	elif _family == "nature":
+		warm = Color("f0ce70")
+		cool = Color("8fce8e")
+	_petal_material.set_shader_parameter("warm_color", warm)
+	_petal_material.set_shader_parameter("cool_color", cool)
+	_pollen_material.albedo_color = Color("ffcf7c")
+	_pollen_material.emission = warm
+	_theme_changes += 1
+
+
+func _material(color: Color, metallic := 0.0) -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	material.albedo_color = color
+	material.metallic = metallic
+	material.roughness = 0.76
+	material.metallic_specular = 0.18
+	return material
+
+
+func _cylinder(top: float, bottom: float, height: float) -> CylinderMesh:
+	var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
+	mesh.top_radius = top
+	mesh.bottom_radius = bottom
+	mesh.height = height
+	mesh.radial_segments = 12
+	return mesh
+
+
+func _sphere() -> SphereMesh:
+	var mesh := SphereMesh.new()
+	mesh.radius = 0.5
+	mesh.height = 1.0
+	mesh.radial_segments = 12
+	mesh.rings = 6
+	return mesh
+
+
+func _batch(label: String, mesh: Mesh, material: Material, count: int, custom := false) -> MultiMeshInstance3D:
+	var multi := MultiMesh.new()
+	multi.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+	multi.use_custom_data = custom
+	multi.mesh = mesh
+	multi.instance_count = count
+	var node := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+	node.name = label
+	node.multimesh = multi
+	node.material_override = material
+	node.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	add_child(node)
+	_batches.append(node)
+	return node
+
+
+func _build_geometry() -> void:
+	_petal_material = ShaderMaterial.new()
+	_petal_material.shader = PETAL_SHADER
+	_pollen_material = _material(Color("ffcf7c"))
+	_pollen_material.emission_enabled = true
+	_pollen_material.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.12
+	_batch("CopperPlanters", _cylinder(0.26, 0.18, 0.3), _material(Color("ad7a51"), 0.08), FLOWERS)
+	_batch("PlanterRims", _cylinder(0.28, 0.28, 0.055), _material(Color("d8b17c"), 0.12), FLOWERS)
+	_batch("GardenSoil", _cylinder(0.235, 0.235, 0.025), _material(Color("384e41")), FLOWERS)
+	_batch("LivingStems", _cylinder(0.027, 0.037, 0.4), _material(Color("54896c")), FLOWERS)
+	_batch("GardenLeaves", _sphere(), _material(Color("74ab86")), FLOWERS * 2)
+	var surface := SurfaceTool.new()
+	surface.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	surface.append_from(_sphere(), 0, Transform3D(Basis.from_scale(Vector3(0.48, 0.075, 0.23)), Vector3(0.24, 0, 0)))
+	_batch("OpeningPetals", surface.commit(), _petal_material, FLOWERS * PETALS, true)
+	_batch("WarmPollen", _sphere(), _pollen_material, FLOWERS)
+
+
+func _position_geometry(portrait: bool) -> void:
+	_positions.clear()
+	for flower in range(FLOWERS):
+		var x := (-0.65 + float(flower) * 0.70) if portrait else (-2.15 + float(flower) * 1.05)
+		var z := -3.85 if _kind == "syllables" and not portrait else -3.55
+		# Leave the rear-right hundred-stock and the lower source label clear.
+		# A side border fits the phone instead of placing flowers behind its HUD.
+		if portrait and _kind == "bridge_hundred":
+			x = -2.65
+			z = -2.8 + float(flower) * 1.55
+		var at := Vector3(x, 0.0, z)
+		_positions.append(at)
+		_set_instance(0, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.15, 0))
+		_set_instance(1, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.30, 0))
+		_set_instance(2, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.332, 0))
+		_set_instance(3, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.50, 0))
+		for leaf in range(2):
+			var side := -1.0 if leaf == 0 else 1.0
+			var basis_value := Basis(Vector3.FORWARD, side * 0.4).scaled(Vector3(0.24, 0.055, 0.10))
+			_set_instance(4, flower * 2 + leaf, at + Vector3(side * 0.1, 0.48 + float(leaf) * 0.1, 0), basis_value)
+		for petal in range(PETALS):
+			var index := flower * PETALS + petal
+			_set_instance(5, index, at + Vector3(0, 0.72, 0))
+			_batches[5].multimesh.set_instance_custom_data(index, Color(float(flower), float(petal) / float(PETALS), float(flower % 2), 1.0))
+		_set_instance(6, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.735, 0), Basis.from_scale(Vector3(0.17, 0.13, 0.17)))
+	for node in _batches:
+		# Covers both bud and fully open shader-deformed petals in either layout.
+		node.multimesh.custom_aabb = AABB(Vector3(-3.2, -0.1, -4.4), Vector3(6.4, 1.6, 8.9))
+	_layout_changes += 1
+
+
+func _set_instance(batch: int, index: int, at: Vector3, basis_value := Basis.IDENTITY) -> void:
+	_batches[batch].multimesh.set_instance_transform(index, Transform3D(basis_value, at))
+
+

+extends SceneTree
+## Reuse the published village scale review against the production collector.
+## Counts are engine nodes, never a renderer frame-rate or device measurement.
+const STATE = preload("res://scripts/creative/build_settlement_state.gd")
+const REGION = preload("res://scripts/creative/build_settlement_region.gd")
+var checks := 0
+var failures: Array[String] = []
+var capture_dir := ""
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	call_deferred("_run")
+
+
+func _check(ok: bool, message: String) -> void:
+	checks += 1
+	if not ok:
+		failures.append(message)
+		push_warning("[VillageScaling] " + message)
+
+
+func _frames(count := 4) -> void:
+	for _frame in range(count):
+		await physics_frame
+
+
+func _counts(city: Node3D) -> Dictionary:
+	var batches: Variant = city.get("overview_nodes")
+	var roofs := 0
+	var distant := 0
+	if batches is Array:
+		for batch: MultiMeshInstance3D in batches:
+			if str(batch.name) == "VillageMap_roofs":
+				roofs += batch.multimesh.instance_count
+			else:
+				distant += batch.multimesh.instance_count
+	return {
+		"nodes": city.find_children("*", "Node", true, false).size(),
+		"meshes": city.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false).size(),
+		"bodies": city.find_children("*", "StaticBody3D", true, false).size(),
+		"detailed": city.facility_nodes.size(),
+		"batches": batches.size() if batches is Array else 0,
+		"distant": distant,
+		"roofs": roofs
+	}
+
+
+func _assert_budget(city: Node3D, label: String) -> void:
+	var counts := _counts(city)
+	print("[VillageScaling] ", label, " ", JSON.stringify(counts))
+	_check(int(counts.detailed) <= 192, label + ": at most 96 detailed buildings per town")
+	_check(int(counts.batches) <= 4, label + ": at most four shared overview batches")
+	_check(int(counts.meshes) < 4000, label + ": the full model has bounded mesh nodes")
+	_check(int(counts.bodies) < 900, label + ": only nearby plots and buildings have colliders")
+	_check(
+		int(counts.detailed) + int(counts.distant) == 2178,
+		label + ": every model building remains represented near or far"
+	)
+	_check(int(counts.distant) == int(counts.roofs), label + ": distant houses keep their roofs")
+
+
+func _capture(name: String) -> void:
+	if capture_dir.is_empty():
+		return
+	await process_frame
+	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
+	var image := root.get_texture().get_image()
+	_check(image != null and image.get_size() == Vector2i(1280, 720), name + ": actual viewport size")
+	if image != null:
+		_check(image.save_png(capture_dir.path_join(name + ".png")) == OK, name + ": PNG saved")
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	if "--capture" in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
+		capture_dir = OS.get_environment("LUMO_CAPTURE_DIR")
+		if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless" or capture_dir.is_empty():
+			push_error("[VillageScaling] Capture requires an actual renderer and LUMO_CAPTURE_DIR")
+			quit(1)
+			return
+		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(capture_dir)
+	root.size = Vector2i(1280, 720)
+	var router := root.get_node("SceneRouter")
+	router.launch_options = {
+		"childKey": "village_scaling_collector_regression",
+		"buildSlot": 6,
+		"settlementMode": "settlement",
+		"livingVillage": true
+	}
+	var city = load("res://scenes/creative/build_settlement_world.tscn").instantiate()
+	root.add_child(city)
+	await _frames()
+	city.set_physics_process(false)
+	var model = STATE.new("rival", true)
+	for town: Dictionary in [model._player, model._rival]:
+		town.region = 11
+		town.plots = 1089
+		town.population = 2180
+		town.next_id = 1090
+		town.buildings = []
+		town.households = []
+		for index in range(1089):
+			var id := "b%d" % (index + 1)
+			town.buildings.append({"id": id, "kind": "house", "plot": index})
+			town.households.append(
+				{"building_id": id, "adults": 2, "children": 0, "supplied_days": 20}
+			)
+	var saved: Dictionary = model.snapshot()
+	var restored = STATE.restore(JSON.parse_string(JSON.stringify(saved)))
+	_check(restored != null and restored.snapshot() == saved, "The 2178-house fixture is a valid save")
+	city.model = model
+	city.mode = "rival"
+	city.radius = 94
+	city.focus = Vector3(-REGION.TOWN_CENTER, 0, 0)
+	city._rebuild()
+	city._camera_update(true)
+	await _frames()
+	_assert_budget(city, "home")
+	_check(city.facility_nodes.has("p_b5"), "The home center has its actual detailed collider")
+	_check(not city.facility_nodes.has("r_b5"), "The distant neighbor center uses overview geometry")
+	_check(city.model.snapshot() == saved, "Building presentation preserves all saved economy data")
+	await _capture("01-home-region")
+
+	city.focus = Vector3(REGION.TOWN_CENTER, 0, 0)
+	city._camera_update(true)
+	await _frames()
+	_assert_budget(city, "neighbor")
+	_check(city.facility_nodes.has("r_b5"), "Camera movement activates the neighbor's real center")
+	_check(not city.facility_nodes.has("p_b5"), "Camera movement retires distant home detail")
+	_check(city.model.snapshot() == saved, "Camera movement does not mutate the economy")
+
+	city.focus = Vector3.ZERO
+	city._camera_update(true)
+	await _frames()
+	_assert_budget(city, "river")
+	await _capture("02-river-boundary")
+
+	# The ordinary physics callback must follow the explorer, not the planning camera.
+	city._toggle_walk()
+	city.explorer.start_at(Vector3(-REGION.TOWN_CENTER, 0.08, 0))
+	city._physics_process(0.0)
+	await _frames()
+	_check(city.facility_nodes.has("p_b5"), "Walking refreshes the actual home-center collider")
+	city.explorer.start_at(Vector3(REGION.TOWN_CENTER, 0.08, 0))
+	city._physics_process(0.0)
+	await _frames()
+	_assert_budget(city, "walking_neighbor")
+	_check(city.facility_nodes.has("r_b5"), "Explorer movement activates the neighbor collider")
+	_check(not city.facility_nodes.has("p_b5"), "Explorer movement retires distant home detail")
+	_check(city.model.snapshot() == saved, "Exploring preserves the full simulation and save")
+	city._toggle_walk()
+	await _frames()
+	_assert_budget(city, "planning_restored")
+	_check(city.model.snapshot() == saved, "Returning to planning preserves both villages")
+	city.queue_free()
+	await _frames()
+	if failures.is_empty():
+		print("[VillageScaling] PASS ", checks, " checks: full 2178-house model, camera and explorer")
+		quit(0)
+	else:
+		print("[VillageScaling] FAIL ", checks, " checks: ", failures)
+		quit(1)

+static func inspect(hub: Node) -> Dictionary:

+		"skinned_meshes": 0, "vertices": 0, "visible_vertices": 0,

+		"headless": DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless"}

+	if actor == null:
+		failures.append("Original Lumo actor is absent")
+		return result
+	var source: Script = actor.get_script()
+	result.adapter = source.resource_path if source != null else ""
+	if result.adapter != ADAPTER:
+		failures.append("Hub must use the same original rig adapter as the learning world")
+		return result
+	if not actor.call("is_usable"):
+		failures.append("The original model did not load a usable rig")

+	var skeleton := actor.get("skeleton") as Skeleton3D
+	var player := actor.get("player") as AnimationPlayer
+	result.model = visual.scene_file_path
+	result.load_kind = str(actor.get("model_load_kind"))
+	result.bones = skeleton.get_bone_count()
+	if result.model != MODEL or result.load_kind != "imported_packed_scene":
+		failures.append("Hub must instantiate the imported original facial GLB")
+	if result.bones != 65:
+		failures.append("The original 65-bone skeleton is required")
+	for bone in ["Head", "Hand.L", "Hand.R", "Foot.L", "Foot.R"]:
+		if skeleton.find_bone(bone) < 0:

+		"kart_seated", "kart_steer_left", "kart_steer_right", "kart_jump"]:
+		if not player.has_animation(clip):
+			failures.append("Original animation is missing: " + clip)
+		else:
+			result.clips.append(clip)
+	for node in visual.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
+		var mesh := node as MeshInstance3D
+		if mesh.mesh == null or mesh.skin == null:
+			continue
+		if not mesh.mesh.resource_path.begins_with(MODEL + "::"):
+			failures.append("A visible skin is not sourced from the original GLB")
+		if mesh.get_node_or_null(mesh.skeleton) != skeleton:
+			failures.append("Original mesh is not bound to the real skeleton")
+		result.skinned_meshes += 1
+		result.mesh_resources.append(mesh.mesh.resource_path)
+		for surface in range(mesh.mesh.get_surface_count()):

+			var point := camera.unproject_position(mesh.to_global(mesh.get_aabb().get_endpoint(corner)))

+			first = false
+	return result

+	# cuboid containing impossible combinations of maximum X/Y/Z deflection.
+	var found := false

+	var progress: float = garden._petal_material.get_shader_parameter("progress")

+const BRIDGE = preload("res://scripts/systems/host_bridge.gd")

+class TestHost:

+
+	func returnToApp(destination: String, payload: String) -> int:
+		returns.append({"destination": destination, "payload": JSON.parse_string(payload)})

+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	var errors: Array[String] = []
+	var good := BRIDGE.validated_options({
+		"game": "settlement",
+		"livingVillage": true,
+		"settlementMode": "settlement",
+		"grade": 2,
+		"subject": "Mathematik",
+		"childKey": "child-test",
+		"buildSlot": 3
+	})
+	if good.get("scene", "") != "settlement":
+		errors.append("Economic village was silently rerouted away from settlement")
+	if good.get("livingVillage", false) != true:
+		errors.append("Validated launch lost explicit village request")
+	if good.get("childKey") != "child-test" or good.get("grade") != 2:
+		errors.append("Original child identity or grade was lost")
+	# Boot references global EventBus; compiling it from a SceneTree test
+	# fails before project autoloads exist. Source-gate its registered maps
+	# while the project import independently compiles the production scene.
+	var boot_text := FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://scripts/app/app_boot.gd")
+	var cover_section := boot_text.get_slice("const COVER_BY_SCENE: Dictionary = {", 1).get_slice("}", 0)
+	var title_section := boot_text.get_slice("const TITLE_BY_SCENE: Dictionary = {", 1).get_slice("}", 0)
+	if not title_section.contains('"settlement":'):
+		errors.append("Android boot does not label this new village scene")
+	if not cover_section.contains('"settlement":'):
+		errors.append("Village opening lacks a real game cover")
+	var boot_selector := boot_text.get_slice('var target: String = requested if requested in [', 1).get_slice(']', 0)
+	if not boot_selector.contains('"settlement"'):
+		errors.append("Native boot cannot load the settlement scene")
+	if not root.get_node("SceneRouter").SCENES.has("settlement"):
+		errors.append("SceneRouter lacks the real settlement scene")
+	var forbidden := BRIDGE.validated_options({
+		"game": "settlement", "livingVillage": false
+	})
+	if forbidden.get("scene") == "settlement":
+		errors.append("Unsupported classic settlement should not be launched from the village portal")
+	await _check_actual_return_context(errors, good)
+	if not errors.is_empty():
+		for item in errors:
+			printerr("[VillageHost] FAIL " + item)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Collect one fresh, exact-source Discovery run; no retries or existing-run reuse."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+if __package__:
+    from . import verify_discovery_connections as gate
+else:
+    import verify_discovery_connections as gate
+
+
+def write_json(path, value):
+    gate.require(not path.is_symlink(), "Refusing a symlink output")
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def fresh_output(project, requested):
+    output = Path(os.path.abspath(requested))
+    gate.no_symlink_path(output)
+    gate.require(output != project and project not in output.parents, "Evidence must be outside the Native checkout")
+    gate.require(not output.exists(), "Discovery output must not already exist")
+    gate.require(output.parent.is_dir(), "Create only the external evidence parent before collection")
+    output.mkdir()
+    return output
+
+
+def collect(project: Path, output: Path, expected_sha: str, expected_tree: str, godot: str):
+    project = Path(os.path.abspath(project))
+    gate.no_symlink_path(project)
+    gate.require(project.is_dir(), "Native checkout required")
+    gate.require(gate.SHA1.fullmatch(expected_sha) and gate.SHA1.fullmatch(expected_tree),
+                 "Exact Native HEAD and tree are required")
+    for key, value in (("LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_SHA", expected_sha), ("LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_TREE", expected_tree)):
+        gate.require(not os.environ.get(key) or os.environ[key] == value, "Conflicting expected source environment")
+    env = {**os.environ, "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
+           "GODOT_SILENCE_ROOT_WARNING": "1"}
+
+    def git(*args):
+        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(project), *args], env=env)
+
+    gate.require(git("rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").decode().strip() == str(project), "Project must be the Git root")
+    gate.require(git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip() == expected_sha and
+                 git("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}").decode().strip() == expected_tree, "Foreign Native checkout")
+    gate.require(git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no") == b"", "Dirty tracked Native checkout/index")
+    output = fresh_output(project, output)
+    (output / "helpers").mkdir()
+    (output / "logs").mkdir()
+    (output / "captures").mkdir()
+    calls = {"schema": 1, "completed": False, "calls": []}
+    write_json(output / "invocations.json", calls)
+    (output / "results.tsv").write_text("probe\tmode\tresult\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    for name, (sha, blob) in gate.HELPERS.items():
+        path = project / "tools" / name
+        gate.no_symlink_path(path)
+        data = path.read_bytes()
+        actual = gate.identity(data)
+        gate.require(actual["sha256"] == sha and actual["git_blob"] == blob,
+                     "Published helper hash differs before import: " + name)
+        (output / "helpers" / name).write_bytes(data)
+    for name, actual_path in (("collect_discovery_connections.py", Path(__file__)),
+                              ("verify_discovery_connections.py", Path(gate.__file__))):
+        data = (project / "tools" / name).read_bytes()
+        gate.require(data == actual_path.read_bytes(), "Collector must execute the exact checkout source")
+        (output / "helpers" / name).write_bytes(data)
+    dream = gate.bound_module(output, "verify_dream_rasters.py")
+
+    def snapshot(phase):
+        suffix = "" if phase == "before" else "-after"
+        (output / ("source-sha" + suffix + ".txt")).write_bytes(git("rev-parse", "HEAD"))
+        (output / ("source-tree" + suffix + ".txt")).write_bytes(git("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"))
+        (output / ("source-dirty" + suffix + ".txt")).write_bytes(
+            git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"))
+        (output / ("source-tree-" + phase + ".bin")).write_bytes(git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", "HEAD"))
+        index = Path(os.fsdecode(git("rev-parse", "--git-path", "index")).strip())
+        if not index.is_absolute():
+            index = project / index
+        (output / ("source-index-" + phase + ".bin")).write_bytes(index.read_bytes())
+        return dream.snapshot_source(project, output, phase)
+
+    (output / "source-commit.raw").write_bytes(git("cat-file", "commit", expected_sha))
+    failure = None
+    try:
+        initial = snapshot("before")
+        gate.require(all(row["materialized"] is True for row in initial["tracked"]),
+                     "This full-checkout CI requires every tracked source byte before running probes")
+        executable = shutil.which(godot)
+        gate.require(executable is not None, "Godot executable not found")
+        engine = Path(executable).resolve(strict=True)
+        binary = dream.disk_identity(engine)
+        write_json(output / "engine-binary.json", {"path": str(engine), "bytes": binary["bytes"],
+                                                  "sha256": binary["sha256"]})
+        version = subprocess.run([str(engine), "--version"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                                 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env, timeout=20, check=False)
+        (output / "engine.txt").write_bytes(version.stdout)
+        gate.require(version.returncode == 0 and version.stdout == (gate.ENGINE + "\n").encode(),
+                     "Unexpected Godot engine identity")
+        display = os.environ.get("DISPLAY", "")
+        if display:
+            gate.require(gate.re.fullmatch(r":[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?", display), "Use a local display only")
+            renderer_prefix = []
+        else:
+            xvfb = shutil.which("xvfb-run")
+            gate.require(xvfb is not None, "A genuine X11 renderer requires DISPLAY or xvfb-run")
+            renderer_prefix = [str(Path(xvfb).absolute()), "-a", "-s", "-screen 0 2560x2560x24"]
+        context = {"schema": 1, "native_source": expected_sha, "native_tree": expected_tree,
+                   "project": str(project), "output": str(output), "output_was_absent": True,
+                   "godot": str(engine), "python": str(Path(sys.executable).absolute()),
+                   "renderer_prefix": renderer_prefix, "display": display,
+                   "started_monotonic_ns": time.monotonic_ns()}
+        write_json(output / "collection-context.json", context)
+        for item in gate.invocation_plan(context):
+            for key in ("XDG_DATA_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME"):
+                Path(item["environment"][key]).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+            call = {**item, "started_monotonic_ns": time.monotonic_ns(),
+                    "finished_monotonic_ns": None, "returncode": None, "outer_timeout": False}
+            calls["calls"].append(call)
+            write_json(output / "invocations.json", calls)
+            print(f"[DiscoveryCollector] START {item['ordinal']}/10 {item['probe']} "
+                  f"{item['mode']} deadline={item['timeout_seconds']}s", flush=True)
+            with (output / item["runner_log"]).open("xb") as transcript:
+                # The unchanged source-bound runner owns its original per-probe
+                # deadline and five-second TERM/KILL grace. No retry or extension.
+                process = subprocess.Popen(item["command"], cwd=project,
+                                           stdout=transcript, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+                                           env={**env, **item["environment"]})
+                code = process.wait()
+            call.update(finished_monotonic_ns=time.monotonic_ns(), returncode=code)
+            write_json(output / "invocations.json", calls)
+            print(f"[DiscoveryCollector] END {item['ordinal']}/10 returncode={code}", flush=True)
+            gate.require(code == 0, "Original Discovery probe failed: " + item["probe"])
+            text = gate.read(output, item["log"]).decode("utf-8")
+            gate.require(gate.ERRORS.search(text) is None and text.splitlines().count(item["marker"]) == 1,
+                         "Original error/leak or missing/duplicate marker: " + item["probe"])
+            with (output / "results.tsv").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as results:
+                results.write(item["probe"] + "\t" + item["mode"] + "\tPASS\n")
+        calls.update(completed=True, finished_monotonic_ns=time.monotonic_ns())
+        write_json(output / "invocations.json", calls)
+    except Exception as error:
+        failure = error
+        write_json(output / "collection-failure.json", {"schema": 1, "error": type(error).__name__,
+                                                      "message": str(error), "successful_collection": False})
+    finally:
+        # Preserve tracked/index failures and generated UIDs independently. Never clean.
+        try:
+            snapshot("after")
+        except Exception as error:
+            write_json(output / "source-finalization-failure.json",
+                       {"error": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
+            if failure is None:
+                failure = error
+    if failure is not None:
+        raise failure
+    result = gate.verify(output, expected_native_sha=expected_sha, expected_native_tree=expected_tree, write=False)
+    write_json(output / gate.MANIFEST, result)
+    print(gate.PASS)
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--project", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--expected-native-sha", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--expected-native-tree", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--godot", default=os.environ.get("GODOT_BIN", "godot"))
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    collect(args.project, args.output, args.expected_native_sha, args.expected_native_tree, args.godot)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Required after validate_live_connections.sh; keeps the existing 9/7 contract intact.
+set -euo pipefail
+ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
+cd "$ROOT"
+LOG_DIR="${LUMO_DISCOVERY_LOG_DIR:-$ROOT/.artifacts/discovery-connections}"
+mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG_DIR")"
+mkdir "$LOG_DIR"
+LOG_DIR="$(cd "$LOG_DIR" && pwd)"
+mkdir "$LOG_DIR/captures"
+export GODOT_SILENCE_ROOT_WARNING=1
+export LP_NUM_THREADS="${LP_NUM_THREADS:-2}"
+
+PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools:tools/tests \
+  python3 -m unittest test_discovery_rasters 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/evidence-checker-tests.log"
+
+probe() {
+  local name="$1" mode="$2" seconds="$3" marker="$4"
+  shift 4
+  local log="$LOG_DIR/${name}-${mode}.log"
+  local -a args=(--path "$ROOT" --audio-driver Dummy --script "res://scripts/tests/${name}.gd" "$@")
+  export XDG_DATA_HOME="$LOG_DIR/user-data/${name}-${mode}"
+  export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$LOG_DIR/cache/${name}-${mode}"
+  if [[ "$mode" == headless ]]; then
+    timeout "${seconds}s" godot --headless "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
+  elif [[ -n "${DISPLAY:-}" ]]; then
+    timeout "${seconds}s" godot --rendering-method gl_compatibility "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
+  elif command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    timeout "${seconds}s" xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' \
+      godot --rendering-method gl_compatibility "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
+  else
+    local rendered="$LOG_DIR/${name}-${mode}-display"
+    python3 tools/run_local_renderer.py --project "$ROOT" \
+      --display "${LUMO_DISCOVERY_DISPLAY:-145}" --output "$rendered" --timeout "$seconds" \
+      -- "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
+    cat "$rendered/godot.log" | tee -a "$log"
+  fi
+  if grep -En 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:|Assertion failed|ObjectDB instances leaked|resources still in use at exit' "$log"; then
+    echo "The original discovery probe failed: $name ($mode)" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+  grep -Fx "$marker" "$log"
+}

+            all(ord(c) >= 32 and ord(c) != 127 for c in value) and
+            ".." not in PurePosixPath(value).parts and str(PurePosixPath(value)) == value,

+def record(root, relative):
+    return {"path": relative, **identity(read(root, relative))}

+def parse_json(data):

+        result = {}
+        for key, value in items:
+            require(key not in result, "Duplicate JSON key: " + key)
+            result[key] = value
+        return result

+    def constant(value):
+        raise ValueError("Nonfinite JSON value: " + value)

+def tree_entries(data):

+    for row in data.split(b"\0"):

+        mode, kind, blob = metadata.decode("ascii").split()

+    root = {}

+        for part in parts[:-1]:

+        require(parts[-1] not in node, "Duplicate Git tree path")

+            value = node[name]
